__comment: Coinbase CDP Policy Engine — signing-layer backstop. Attach to the account (or project). The Policy Engine is fail-secure (no matching accept rule => reject). x402's EVM 'exact' scheme signs an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization as EIP-712 typed data (operation signEvmTypedData, or signEndUserEvmTypedData for a delegated embedded wallet), so the rule matches the typed-data message fields: 'to' as a recipient allowlist and 'value' as a per-transaction cap (USDC base units, 6 decimals). Both hold on Base Sepolia testnet because they compare raw typed-data fields; only the separate netUSDChange criterion is mainnet-only. A signEvmTransaction rule would NOT match this op and, being fail-secure, would deny the signing the payment depends on. Requires an API key with the policies#manage scope, applied in the CDP project that owns the wallet. Docs: https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/wallets/security-and-policies/policy-engine/overview
description: Secure payment agent x402 recipient and cap
